name: tasks-platform
description: API multi-tenant de gestion de tareas

scripts.postinstall: pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/contracts build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/shared build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/api exec prisma generate
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/shared run build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/api run dev
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/shared run build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/worker run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tasks-platform/shared run build && pnpm -r --if-present run build
